title: Isolation of Klebsiella Strains from Food Samples
author: MedVetKlebs consortium
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.baxtifnn

steps.title: Prepare sample suspension
steps.instruction: Cut the food sample into small slivers until you obtain a total weight of 25 g.

steps.title: Dilute sample in BPW
steps.instruction: Add the 25 g of sample to 225 ml of Buffered Peptone Water (BPW) broth to achieve a 1:10 dilution.

steps.title: Homogenize sample
steps.instruction: Mix the suspension using a stomacher for 30 seconds, or alternatively pulse it briefly with a blender.

steps.title: Pre‑enrichment incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the homogenized suspension at 37 °C ± 1 °C for 24 h ± 1 h.

steps.title: Plate on selective SCAI agar
steps.instruction: Using a 10 μl inoculating loop, streak the incubated suspension for single colonies onto a 90 mm petri dish containing SCAI medium, then incubate the plate at 44 °C ± 1 °C for 48 h ± 1 h.

substeps.instruction: Observe colony morphology after 24 h; colonies typical of Klebsiella are yellow, moist, and dome‑shaped, but 48 h gives clearer discrimination.
If the SCAI medium turns completely yellow (high inositol‑fermenting load), consider diluting the sample before streaking to improve colony separation.
Typical Klebsiella colonies appear yellow; E. coli colonies remain white because they do not ferment inositol.

steps.title: Select and subculture suspect colonies
steps.instruction: Pick yellow colonies that are suspected Klebsiella and streak them onto a non‑selective agar plate (e.g., LB or TSA) to obtain isolated colonies, then incubate at 37 °C ± 1 °C for 24 h ± 1 h (up to 48 h if needed).

substeps.instruction: If colonies are numerous or touching, re‑isolate the colony on a fresh SCAI plate before subculturing to ensure purity.

steps.title: Identify species of isolates
steps.instruction: Determine the species of the purified suspect colonies using MALDI‑TOF mass spectrometry and/or species‑specific PCR.

steps.title: Store confirmed Klebsiella isolates
steps.instruction: Freeze confirmed Klebsiella pneumoniae (or related species) isolates at –80 °C in CryoBank tubes or an equivalent cryoprotective medium (e.g., BHI broth with 15 % glycerol). If multiple morphotypes are present, store one colony per morphotype.

steps.title: Optional storage of remaining plate
steps.instruction: If desired, after picking the selected colonies, sweep the remaining content of the SCAI plate into CryoBank tubes (or equivalent, e.g., in‑house BHI + 15 % glycerol) and freeze at –80 °C for downstream mixed‑colonies sequencing.
